name: Duel Style
descriptionText: Duel style is focused on creating the perfect environment for a 1 on 1 fight.

abilities.name: Duel Style
abilities.rulesText: At the start of your turn, Challenge and enemy, holding your Hatred Token. The first time each turn, when an enemy Challenged by you deal damage to you, you deal 2 damage back to them, if they are within your range. A character holding your Challenge Token cannot move away from you or teleport in a way, that would increase the distance between you two. You are affected by the same effect.

actions.name: Exchange Strikes
actions.rulesText:
Force an enemy Challenged by you to deal 1 damage to you. Afterwards, Heal 1 and deal 2 damage to them.
8+: Force an enemy Challenged by you to deal 2 damage to you. Afterwards, Heal 2 and deal 3 damage to them.
12+: Force an enemy Challenged by you to deal 2 damage to you. Afterwards, Heal 2 and deal 3 damage to them.

actions.name: Clash!
actions.rulesText:
Pull up to 1 to an enemy with your Hatred Token, then, Pull yourself up to 1 to them
5+: Pull 3 in both cases instead
10+: Pull 5 in both cases, and both of you deal 1 damage to each other

actions.name: Anticipate Retaliation
actions.rulesText:
Heal. If you have been damaged by a character, holding your Hatred Token this turn, gain 1 Iron Token,
6+: Also gain Temporary Armor and Heal 1
10+: Also give the enemy holding your Challenge Token 3 Weakness Tokens
